research.name: Avenra Liquid Glass
research.note: Zero-dependency library that renders glass buttons, sliders and switches with Snell's-law SVG refraction and spring physics.

effects: SVG displacement-map refraction computed from Snell's law to imitate light bending through a glass bezel
Liquid glass toggle switch, slider and button driven by damped spring physics

unverified: The component source is public at github.com/DevSam7t3/liquid-glass (MIT); that repository has not been researched in place of this site yet.
The demo was seen only as a static headless screenshot of the Liquid Switch preview, so the refraction and spring motion were not observed moving.
